entities.name: UniProt Q8K903
observations: Exact sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed Buchnera aphidicola subsp. Schizaphis graminum low-affinity inorganic phosphate transporter.
Annotated as a multipass cell-membrane phosphate transporter; GO:0005315 phosphate transmembrane transporter activity and GO:0035435 phosphate ion transmembrane transport.
Related reviewed E. coli PitA homolog P0AFJ9 shares 55.1% identity and 99.4% query coverage.
